verdict.rationale: Vanta's first-party pages say it automatically gathers evidence and continuously monitors connected systems (vanta-docs-45, vanta-docs-16). It integrates with cloud, identity, and version-control tools, including 40+ AWS resources, and runs automated tests (vanta-docs-26, vanta-docs-40, vanta-docs-10), and its API plus Custom Tests extend collection to homegrown systems (vanta-docs-32, vanta-docs-2). missing for 10: documented collection schedule or cadence, explicit timestamping and provenance of gathered artifacts, evidence that automated collection replaces screenshots or CSV uploads, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages.
